scenes.setting: Steve's Biological Poison Bottle sickens the field — but the Sun Brooch dilutes it, and Klein's masterstroke lands: a bullet unearths the whistle-and-Master-Key ring, the undead riot for it, and grabbing it feeds Steve the Master Key's full-moon curse-scream; the freed Scarlet Lunar Corona is flicked to Sharron, her bronze Door reopens on Steve, and six holy bullets hammer his burning head
scenes.text_anchor: a faint but very strange sound entered his mind, ripping at his nerves and scraping his scalp
